hero.name: Alejo Gonzalez Fittipaldi
hero.lead: I combine UX/UI design, frontend development and product thinking to build websites and online stores.

paragraphs: For more than 7 years I've been designing and building digital products, focused on websites and online stores.
I started as a web designer and grew into the role of Product Expert. Along the way, I led end-to-end web projects for more than 50 retail, wholesale and B2B clients.
What defines me most is my client focus: I understand what the business needs, manage expectations and turn requirements into clear solutions that can grow with the brand.
Today I bring frontend development together with my design and product experience, and I am looking for new projects and teams where I can contribute that dual perspective.
